shulker_stickers.help.first_place: Tip: sneak and right-click a placed shulker box with an empty hand to recolor it, rename it, or stick the item in your off-hand on it. Type /shulkerstickers help to see this again.
shulker_stickers.help.text: Shulker Stickers: sneak and right-click a placed shulker box with an empty main hand to open the Sticker editor. Pick a color, click "Use off-hand item" to stick the item in your off-hand on the box (you keep the item), or rename the box. Click Save to apply everything, or Cancel (Esc) to discard. /shulkerstickers toggle turns the gesture off for you.
